mods:mods.mods:note: This item was digitised in 2012 as part of a project to digitise Scottish gazetteers. The collection was digitised by the Internet Archive, at the National Library of Scotland’s Causewayside studio. Transcriptions were generated from optical character recognition (OCR) performed by the Internet Archive. The collection was digitised to meet user interest in topography and place, acting as reference sources to complement the detailed maps of Scotland digitised by the National Library of Scotland. The digitisation was funded by the National Library of Scotland.
